feature_representation.invariance: Invariant to sample-norm variance (45x-117x dynamic range eliminated)

classifier_head.layers: Linear(2048, 512) -> BatchNorm1d(512) -> ReLU -> Dropout(0.10) -> Linear(512, 256) -> BatchNorm1d(256) -> ReLU -> Dropout(0.05) -> Linear(256, C)

acquisition_strategy.name: Pool-Relative Cosine Farthest Diversity with Density Regularization
acquisition_strategy.diversity_metric: Cosine Distance to Labeled Pool (1.0 - max_{y in L} x_hat . y_hat)

density_regularizer.purpose: Prevents boundary-trapping in large spatial parcels without sacrificing class discovery

pseudo_labeling.status: Disabled in Default Configuration (Retained as Ablation)
pseudo_labeling.reason: At low budgets (N <= 180), uncalibrated pseudo-labels induce confirmation bias and 9-13% accuracy drops. Only provides marginal gains at N >= 645.
